name: emergency-halt-web
//: WHY genlayer-js IS PINNED TO 1.1.8 -- DO NOT 'UPGRADE' THIS WITHOUT READING:
2.0.0-rc.1 is broken for reads. Its makeCalldataObject() writes the method under an
empty-string key (ret[''] = method, dist/index.js:279) where the node expects 'method',
so every readContract() fails with 'gen_call: execution failed'. Verified 2026-10-02.
The RC is only needed for studio-dev's fee-aware addTransaction ABI -- and studio-dev
cannot execute contracts at all, so the RC bought no functionality and cost the frontend
its entire read path. python-side deploys keep their own encoding in deploy/fees_aware.py.
